categories.main_business_segments: Wangsu Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two core business segments: Content Delivery Network (CDN) and Edge Computing, and Cloud Security. The company also provides computing cloud services, Internet Data Center (IDC) and liquid cooling energy-saving solutions, managed service provider (MSP) services, and equipment sales including network and computing devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as CDN architecture, edge computing platforms (ECP), AI integration, cloud-native and serverless container technologies, and liquid cooling for data centers. It employs distributed serverless container services based on Kubernetes, AI-driven security models, and proprietary liquid cooling technology developed by its subsidiary Green Cloud Map.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Wangsu serves a diverse customer base including internet companies, government agencies, enterprises across industries such as video streaming, e-commerce, gaming, finance, automotive, retail, media, education, and healthcare. Its services cater to both domestic Chinese markets and international clients, especially in emerging markets along the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in Asia, North America, South America, Europe, Oceania, and Africa. It has established subsidiaries and teams in countries including Singapore, South Korea, Japan, the United States, Malaysia, Ireland, Canada, India, the UK, and Hong Kong, supporting a global intelligent service network.
categories.supply_chain_position: Wangsu operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the IT infrastructure supply chain, providing IT foundational platforms and services such as CDN, edge computing, cloud security, and data center solutions. It acts as a service provider enabling content delivery, computing, and security for end customers rather than manufacturing hardware components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on enhancing its edge computing platform and security access services, integrating AI capabilities, and expanding global market reach. R&D priorities include upgrading CDN architecture, automating overseas traffic planning, real-time data feedback for CDN scheduling, endpoint security enhancements, and developing intelligent security platforms. It also invests in green data center technologies and liquid cooling solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Wangsu generates revenue mainly through service fees for CDN and edge computing, cloud security subscriptions, IDC hosting and leasing, liquid cooling equipment sales and installation, and managed cloud services. Revenue recognition is based on contract terms, including fixed monthly fees and usage-based billing, with income recognized upon customer control transfer of services or products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading global IT infrastructure platform provider with strong technical capabilities and a comprehensive product portfolio. It competes in the CDN, edge computing, and cloud security markets, ranking among the top five in China's cloud Web Application Firewall and public cloud anti-DDoS markets. It emphasizes global network coverage and integrated security solutions to differentiate from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Wangsu reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.93 billion, a 4.81% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 674.5 million, up 10.02%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 12.09 billion, growing 10.24% from the previous year. Overseas revenue accounted for 57.66% of total revenue, reflecting strong international expansion. R&D investment was RMB 447 million, about 9.07% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Wangsu emphasizes delivering fast, stable, and secure IT infrastructure services globally, leveraging its extensive edge node network and integrated AI-driven security solutions. Its edge computing platform offers low-latency, intelligent, and secure user experiences at the network edge. The company’s liquid cooling technology supports energy-efficient green data centers, and its comprehensive security offerings provide full-stack protection tailored to diverse industry needs.
